note: All identifiers are synthetic. The invalid set deliberately includes the PHI-shaped mistakes (payload-in-event, attrs-clear-text-mrn, attrs-hmac-not-fixed-length-hex, attrs-free-text-value, attrs-too-many-entries, attrs-hl7-delimiters, claim-check-presigned-url, record-with-attrs) so a regression cannot reintroduce them quietly. These eight are EVENT_PHI_GUARDS in tests/conformance: asserted by name, never skipped.
expectation_note: Each 'invalid' entry carries expected_json_path and expected_validator: the failing location and JSON Schema keyword that example MUST produce, so an example that fails for the wrong reason goes red instead of passing (code-reviewer Medium 2, Phase 0 gate). This matters most for the five PHI guards: before it, a guard could pass while no longer guarding anything. Values were MEASURED by qa-engineer against jsonschema Draft 2020-12 and hand-checked against each 'violates' line; paths and keywords only, never instance values, so they are PHI-safe.

valid.note: Receive, with a hashed searchable attribute. The 64-hex SHAPE is what the schema checks; the hashing mechanism is UNRESOLVED (README 3.1), so do not read this example as a recommendation to emit identifier-derived attrs yet
Deliberate drop: status dropped, no error code
Failed attempt with a code and a redacted message
Step failure routed to the DLQ
Blocking retry paused a partition; triggering message id included
Partition resumed; duration_ms is the outage length

Ordinary reject (envelope 2.3.1): identity was readable, one non-identity header was malformed and has been normalised on the DLQ record. attrs.bad_header names the offending header, which is safe because only REGISTERED header names can trigger a parse reject - the names are ours, the values are the sender's
kind=record: a record whose headers could not be decoded, identified by topic/partition/offset. message_id is the id minted for the DLQ quarantine wrapper, never a value read out of the broken record

invalid.violates: partition_paused is not a message stage
ts must be an RFC 3339 UTC string, not an epoch float
additionalProperties: no payload field exists; payload bytes must never enter _tb.events (invariant 6)
attrs key must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$ (this one fails on casing and the hyphen only; see attrs-clear-text-mrn for the PHI rule)
attrs key 'mrn' denotes a direct identifier and is rejected in clear form; it is admissible only as 'mrn_hmac'
invalid.expectation_note: The 'not' keyword is the deny-list of identifier names. If this ever reports 'pattern' instead, the example is failing on key casing and the deny-list has stopped being tested — which is exactly the defect security finding 2 fixed

invalid.violates: an _hmac-suffixed value must be exactly 64 hex characters, so a clear-text value cannot hide behind the suffix
non-hashed attrs values are short codes: no spaces, 64 characters max, which rejects free text that can carry PHI
attrs is capped at 16 entries; 17 short codes is a metadata column being used as a payload channel (security finding 7)
an attrs value may not contain HL7 delimiters (| ^ ~ \ &) or CR/LF, so a segment cannot be carried verbatim into the archive (security finding 7)
claim_check must not contain a query string; a presigned URL becomes a stored, replayable credential in ClickHouse and the browser
stage enum: 'enriched' is a pipeline step name, not a lifecycle stage
kind=record requires topic, partition and offset: they are the only identity an unidentifiable record has, and without them the event cannot be joined to the quarantined bytes
invalid.expectation_note: Added 2026-09-22 with the quarantine shape. MEASURED by qa-engineer at f5bc92d; same if/then shape as message-without-message-id.json, which reports at $ for the same reason

invalid.violates: a quarantine event carries no attrs: every value would be derived from the broken record's own bytes, and attrs become searchable columns in ClickHouse and the browser (invariant 6). 'first_bytes: MSH' is the plausible mistake - an HL7 segment start smuggled into a metadata column
invalid.expectation_note: MEASURED by qa-engineer at f5bc92d. PHI GUARD, listed in EVENT_PHI_GUARDS (8 guards) so it is asserted by name and never skipped. The 'not' is at $ because it sits at the branch level inside the kind=record 'then', unlike the attrs deny-list which reports at $.attrs - if this ever reports elsewhere, the no-attrs rule has moved and the guard is no longer guarding it
